After implementation of the Project which will be managed end-to-end by TCS, the Ministry expects the process of issuing a new passport to be completed in three working days, while passports issued under the Tatkal scheme will be dispatched on the same day, subject to address and police verifications of applicants. The Master Service Agreement was signed between representatives of TCS and the MEA in New Delhi today.
